title: Ordered Threaded Map with Error Aggregation
instructions: Implement `SafeCounter` and `threaded_map` in `tmap.py` using only `threading` and `queue`. Workers pull indices from a `queue.Queue`, results keep input order, at most `workers` threads run, and every failure is collected and raised together as an `ExceptionGroup` after all threads have been joined. Do not sleep or busy-wait.

evidence.label: Results keep input order when finish order differs
Basic mapping works for several input types and None results
Empty input returns [] without threads; workers < 1 raises ValueError
Items run in parallel up to the worker count
Thread count is bounded by workers and by items
Active workers never exceed the limit and no threads leak
All items run, then an ExceptionGroup is raised in input order
Work is distributed through a queue.Queue
SafeCounter incr returns the new value and value reads it
SafeCounter has no lost updates under contention
